Team —

Quick kickoff for this month’s gatekeeper round-robin and leadership materials. Please treat this as the canonical checklist for next steps so we can lock the QBR pack by EOD Wednesday. High-level: we need stage confirmations, commit/commit-comment for all deals >$25k, and any gate risks surfaced in-line.

Action items (please do these in the order listed):
- Update your Salesforce stage to one of: Commit / Best Case / Upside; leave notes on any stage change (reason + trigger).
- For deals you mark as Commit, add the expected close date and ACV, and fill the "Commit Confidence" field (L/M/H).
- Flag any deals with legal / procurement blockers with a short note and add the linked doc in the attachments field.
- Upload one short (2–3 bullet) risk summary per Commit deal into the shared Drive folder (link below).

I've attached the Forecast_Template_v2.xlsx — use the tab titled "LeadershipPack" for the rows we'll pull into the exec deck. If you're short on time, update only the Commit rows and add a comment on why something is Best Case vs Commit.

Tentative timeline:
- Mon (today): managers update stages + upload risk bullets
- Tue morning: Sales Ops validates/normalizes ACV numbers
- Tue afternoon: Leadership pack built (I will assemble)
- Wed EOD: Deck submitted to execs

I'll schedule a short 30-minute sync at 2:00pm PT to triage questions — invite to follow.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-forecasting-pack
HubSpot: HS-94281

Attachments:

Appreciate this kickoff. Two quick pieces of guidance from leadership: 

- For PO-pending deals, move to Commit only if the customer has provided a firm PO date AND legal has confirmed contract terms (i.e., not just an LOI). Otherwise keep as Best Case and add detailed note.
- Risk bullets: prioritize the top two risks (impact + mitigation). If a deal truly needs more than two bullets, put a 1-line summary then attach a short note or thread (we'll accept up to 4 bullets for exceptions).

Diego — please include a short "data hygiene" pass in your validation step: normalize ACV to ARR-equivalent for multi-year deals. Also attach Leader_Guidance.pdf to the pack so execs have the scoring rubric.

I'll be on the 2:00pm sync; if anyone needs a separate 1:1 for edge cases, DM me and I'll free up 15 min.

Thanks,
